title: Measure remote id reservation against a real opum-ai repository (DEC-179 part 4, measurement before implementation)
description:
DEC-179 part (4) requires MEASUREMENT before any implementation, against a real opum-ai repository (use opum-ai/quest-cli), of three things: (a) a non-forced push of a unique object to refs/quest/ids/- is accepted; (b) a second non-forced push to that same ref with a different object is rejected; (c) the repository rulesets do not touch refs/quest/*. If GitHub refuses custom refs, measure the fallback refs/tags/quest-id/

- only after proving no workflow triggers on that tag pattern. This task is the measurement and its recorded evidence ONLY; the part (4) implementation is a separate later task that consumes this result. Never force-push. Record exactly what was run.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of the three measurements is recorded with the exact command run and the observed result (exit code or API response), not a summary.
The probe prefix used is obviously synthetic and identifiable as a probe.
The ruleset check enumerates every ruleset for opum-ai/quest-cli (and the dev and main branch rules) and states explicitly whether any of them targets refs/quest/*.
Any probe refs left behind on the remote are reported by exact ref name; they are not deleted unless local settings allow it.
If custom refs are refused by GitHub, the refs/tags/quest-id/* fallback is measured, preceded by a record showing that no fleet workflow triggers on that tag pattern.
No force-push was used for any step.
